text:
eve (design): quick idea  users ask to see both token counts and $ equivalent in the preview. proposal: mini-toggle inside the preview (Tokens | USD) and remember preference per user. also mobile: long-press to preview on touch.
kai (frontend): doable but two perf things: 1) fetching conversion rates for each preview = extra calls. suggest cache conversion rates client-side 1h and server-side TTL 1h. 2) don't render both views at once; render the active unit only.
noor (pm): experiment idea: Variant A = default Tokens with unit-toggle, Variant B = USD-only for billing-heavy orgs. Metrics: preview_open_rate, toggle_use_rate, invoice_click_rate, preview_qps, conversion_cache_hit_rate.
dave (infra): infra guardrail: cache exchange rates in edge-cache with 1h TTL, and add per-customer rate-limits on preview endpoint. also add a batch preview endpoint to accept multiple row ids to reduce QPS if we need to prefetch viewport.
anya (a11y): accessibility notes: toggle must be keyboard reachable and announce changes. prefer `role="tablist"` with two tabs `role="tab"` toggling `aria-selected`. If inline preview is used, ensure `role="region" aria-live="polite"` for updates. long-press on mobile must surface an explicit "Preview" button that can also be focused.
eve (design): copy nits: preview header should read "Tokens  last 30 days" when tokens selected, and "Estimated USD  last 30 days" when USD selected. toggle labels: "Tokens" / "USD"  keep terse. don't show invoice download in the inline preview; only show a secondary "View invoice" in the persistent drawer.
kai (frontend): keyboard flow: Tab -> Preview toggle/button -> Enter opens inline preview -> Tab cycles inner links -> Esc closes and returns focus to toggle. Toggle is two buttons or tabs; use `aria-pressed` or `aria-selected`. implementation: render `.preview-shell` always but keep empty until interaction to avoid reflow. lazy-fetch details after 120ms hover/focus or immediate on explicit button press. respects `prefers-reduced-motion`.
dave (infra): server change: add `/billing/preview/batch` accepting `row_ids[]` and optional `denomination=USD|TOKENS`. add per-user LRU cache TTL=300s. debounce client requests 200ms.
noor (pm): mobile UX decision: long-press opens preview for touch users; but also show a small persistent `⋯` affordance in the cell for discoverability. test: cohort A long-press, cohort B explicit `⋯` button. measure accidental opens.
anya (a11y): mobile long-press must not break assistive tech. ensure there's an accessible alternate (the explicit button) and that long-press isn't the only way. add `aria-describedby` linking toggle to hidden summary `preview-summary-{rowId}`.
kai (frontend): dev estimate: 4 days (unit-toggle UI, conversion caching, preview-shell + lazy load, mobile long-press fallback, analytics).
dave (infra): infra estimate: 1.5 days (batch endpoint + edge cache + rate limits).
deploy-bot: :white_check_mark: staging smoke OK 2026-03-28T12:02Z
noor (pm): action items: eve update figma with unit-toggle + mobile long-press frames, kai start feature branch behind flag, dave add cache & batch endpoint, anya write a11y acceptance tests, i'll own the experiment setup.
eve (design): thanks team  i'll post updated frames + microcopy later today :sparkles:
